# Original codec test fixtures

`native-chord.wav` is a three-second synthetic C-major chord generated by the test-only `FeatureChecks.writeChord` helper through the production FluidSynth 2.6.3 engine and bundled TimGM6mb SF2. No commercial song or recording is used.

MP3 was encoded with LAME through lameenc; FLAC with libsndfile through Python SoundFile. M4A is generated during Android testing by `AacFixture` using the platform AAC encoder. These encoders are development tools and are not bundled in the app.

The rendered test audio derives from the GPL-2 TimGM6mb bank and is provided under GPL-2.0-only, with the full TimGM6mb copyright and license in `app/src/main/assets/licenses/TimGM6mb-COPYING.txt`. The Java fixture generator is project source under MIT.
